## Task Signature
Make a repository's integration-test gate independent of shared model services using a test-only local stand-in, preserve assertions, and prove concurrent reliability and fast diagnostic failures.

# pi-identity
pi-identity provides notebook notes with scoped automatic attachment and auditing.
## Note attachment
- Supports `paths:` and `touches:` in note headers following issue #612, commit 7a362d6.
- Path prefixes or globs scope automatic attachment when chats read, edit, grep, or run shell commands against matching paths.
- Touch triggers scope attachment when queued tasks start with matching touches.
- Scopes are configured with `notebook(action="edit", id="<id>", paths=[...], touches=[...])`.
## Auditing
- `notebook(action="audit")` checks note integrity.
- Reported issues can include dead disk paths, lines longer than 240 characters, empty `##` sections, and leftover `(n...)` or `(d...)` references.
- The clean result is `Audit OK: 0 issues`.

# Pi identity
Pi identity provides scoped automatic attachment of living notes and notebook auditing.
## Note scoping
- Supports `paths:` and `touches:` in note headers following #612, commit 7a362d6.
- Path prefixes or globs scope attachment when a chat reads, edits, greps, or runs bash against matching paths.
- Touch triggers scope attachment when a queued task starts with matching touches.
- Scopes can be set using `notebook(action="edit", id="<id>", paths=[...], touches=[...])`.
## Auditing
- Supports `notebook(action="audit")`.
- Audit issues include dead file paths, lines longer than 240 characters, empty level-two sections, and leftover `(n...)` or `(d...)` references.
- The clean result is `Audit OK: 0 issues`.

## Contract
- Answers 19 yes/no checks, alongside wt check, ui-check, and doc-check.
- Usage: `test-check <repo> [--level N] [--json] [--wt-config <file>] [--land-records <file>]`.
- Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 findings, 2 usage error or unreadable input.

## Implementation
- Ops builds on master and lands with wt land; QA owns the standard, seam, failing fixture acceptance tests and blind final check. The land gate is node scripts/select-tests.mjs --for-check.
- bin/test-check is a three-line Node shim calling process.exit(runCli(process.argv.slice(2))); lib/test-check/*.mjs uses ESM/plain Node, files under 500 lines, and lib/wt.mjs's wt.yaml reader. Builds/new dependencies require Ops approval.
- node:test tests live in test/test-check-*.test.mjs, discovered by npm test via scripts/test.sh 'test/*.test.mjs'; fixtures belong in test/fixtures/test-check/, never real repositories.
- Ops installs after landing: ln -s /home/shinelay/projects/agent-tools/bin/test-check ~/.local/bin/test-check. Require a README.md section and doc-check-clean docs/test-check.md.
## Output and scanning
- Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 findings, 2 usage/unreadable input; --json emits one object. QA's seam defines stable UPPER-KEBAB IDs and JSON shape; findings include ID, file[:line], a plain sentence and next step.
- Seam 2 JSON requires seam: 2 and per-check required; observed and human findings are bounded single lines.
- Hold at most one file's text at a time; handle 60,000 test files on Node's default heap. No network, model calls, writes into checked repositories or execution of their tests; identical input yields identical output.
- Seam 2 supports three-hop/argument-list runners, gitignore-aware scanning, current-config land records, release.files, linked worktrees, and fit helpers versus focused tests.

- Cadence is 30 seconds, matching other observer fields.
- Architecture #529 owns the spec amendment and Backend request.
- checked_at is request time, not proof of liveness or the last successful response.
